physics-killer-09.material: 核聚變反應$\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$入面，各粒子嘅質量係$\mathrm{^2H}$：$2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$，$\mathrm{^3H}$：$3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$，$\mathrm{^4He}$：$4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$，中子：$1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$。取$1\,\mathrm{u}$對應嘅能量為$930\,\mathrm{MeV}$，並忽略反應前粒子嘅動能。呢個反應釋放嘅能量$E$，同生成嘅$\mathrm{^4He}$同中子嘅動量大小相等，質量比近似為$4:1$嗰陣，中子擁有嘅動能，依次配對正確嘅係邊個？
physics-killer-09.thinking.0: 牛頓運動定律同狹義相對論（實驗同問題解決） (Inquiry)
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: 核聚變反應$\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$入面，各粒子嘅質量係$\mathrm{^2H}$：$2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$，$\mathrm{^3H}$：$3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$，$\mathrm{^4He}$：$4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$，中子：$1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$。取$1\,\mathrm{u}$對應嘅能量為$930\,\mathrm{MeV}$，並忽略反應前粒子嘅動能。呢個反應釋放嘅能量$E$，同生成嘅$\mathrm{^4He}$同中子嘅動量大小相等，質量比近似為$4:1$嗰陣，中子擁有嘅動能，依次配對正確嘅係邊個？
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: 因為$\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$，所以$E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$。反應後兩個粒子嘅動量大小相等，所以$K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$同$K_{He}:K_n=1:4$。所以$K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$，$K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$。如果將質量反比寫反就係$3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$（錯誤選項②），將能量除半就係錯誤選項③，將$\Delta m$誤算做$0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$就係錯誤選項④。
physics-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
